title: Cosmic Monster Over Field
description: A giant black monster with large white eyes, sharp teeth, and a halo floats in a dark starry sky filled with comets, swirling galaxies, and geometric shapes. Below, a small human figure with a backpack and staff stands on a path through a purple flower field, looking up while holding a string attached to the creature.
prompt: Surreal black and white line art illustration of a giant floating monster with big white eyes, sharp teeth and a halo, its body covered in purple geometric patterns and faces, set against a dark cosmic background filled with swirling galaxies, comets, shooting stars and a red ringed planet. In the foreground, a tiny explorer with backpack and staff stands on a path through a dense field of purple flowers, holding a string tied to the monster, intricate white linework on black, whimsical yet eerie atmosphere.
